criteria.requirement: Add anytree.util.clone_subtree(node, *, factory=None, copy_attributes=None). Traverse children iteratively and clone __dict__-backed nodes into new AnyNode instances by default, preserving order and all nonstructural attributes. Default attribute payload copying is shallow; an explicit callable can choose deep copy or filtering and must return a mapping without structural fields. An optional kwargs factory can preserve a desired node class but must return distinct detached empty NodeMixin/LightNodeMixin nodes, never original nodes. Validate every result before attaching copies. Do not clone external parents or traverse symbolic targets. Reject repeated/cyclic structure and unsupported slots-only source nodes explicitly; preserve the source tree.
